scheme_name: Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Person
description:
The Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Persons is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of India. 

This scheme was launched to provide financial support to individuals with disabilities. 

The scheme aims to enhance the quality of life for differently abled individuals by ensuring their financial independence. 

The initiative is part of the broader agenda to promote inclusivity and empower persons with disabilities in society. 

The scheme was officially launched on December 3, 2015. 

This date coincides with the International Day of Persons with Disabilities, emphasizing the government’s commitment to this cause. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to differently abled persons to meet their daily needs. 

The scheme targets individuals with disabilities who are in need of financial support. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is intended to cover various expenses such as medical treatment, rehabilitation, and assistive devices. 

Eligible individuals can receive a grant of up to INR 50,000. 

This amount is provided as a one-time financial assistance to help with the costs associated with disabilities. 

The scheme is designed to assist individuals with various types of disabilities as defined by the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. 

This includes physical disabilities, visual impairments, hearing impairments, and intellectual disabilities. 

To be eligible for this financial assistance, applicants must meet specific criteria. 

Applicants must be Indian citizens and residents of India. 

The age limit for applicants is set at 18 years and above. 

There is no upper age limit for eligibility under this scheme. 

The income criteria for eligibility stipulates that the annual income of the applicant should not exceed INR 3 lakh. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the assistance reaches those who are genuinely in need. 

In addition to income criteria, applicants must provide proof of their disability. 

This can be done through a disability certificate issued by a recognized medical authority. 

The application process for this scheme is straightforward and user-friendly. 

Interested individuals can apply online through the official government portal. 

The application form requires personal details such as name, age, address, and income details. 

Applicants must also upload their disability certificate as part of the application. 

In addition to the disability certificate, proof of income must be submitted. 

This can include income tax returns or salary slips for salaried individuals. 

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes verification by the concerned authorities. 

The verification process typically takes around 30 days. 

After successful verification, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the applicant’s bank account. 

The disbursement is usually completed within 15 days of verification. 

This ensures that the assistance reaches the beneficiaries in a timely manner. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment. 

The Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities oversees the execution of this scheme. 

For any queries or assistance, individuals can contact the Ministry at their official helpline number. 

The helpline number is 1800 180 1111. 

Additionally, the Ministry has a dedicated website where applicants can find more information. 

The website provides resources and guidance on the application process. 

As of the latest data available, the scheme has benefitted thousands of differently abled individuals across India. 

In the financial year 2021-2022, approximately 10,000 applications were received under this scheme. 

Of these, around 8,000 applications were approved, resulting in significant financial assistance being disbursed. 

The scheme has seen a steady increase in the number of beneficiaries each year. 

The government continues to promote awareness about the scheme to ensure that eligible individuals can access the benefits. 

Workshops and outreach programs are conducted to educate differently abled persons about their rights and available assistance. 

The scheme aligns with the United Nations Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities. 

This convention emphasizes the importance of providing equal opportunities and support to persons with disabilities. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is crucial for improving the living standards of differently abled persons. 

It enables them to purchase necessary assistive devices such as wheelchairs, hearing aids, and prosthetics. 

Moreover, the assistance helps cover medical expenses that may arise due to their disabilities. 

The government also encourages state governments to implement similar schemes at the state level. 

This ensures that the support reaches individuals in rural and remote areas. 

The scheme is part of a larger framework of policies aimed at empowering persons with disabilities. 

These policies include initiatives for education, employment, and social inclusion. 

The government is committed to creating an inclusive society where differently abled individuals can thrive. 

The Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Persons is a vital step in this direction. 

It not only provides financial support but also promotes dignity and self-reliance among individuals with disabilities. 

The scheme continues to evolve based on feedback from beneficiaries and stakeholders. 

Regular assessments are conducted to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the scheme. 

Overall, the Grant of Financial Assistance to Differently Abled Persons is a significant initiative by the Indian government. 

It reflects the commitment to support and empower one of the most vulnerable sections of society. 

Through this scheme, the government aims to build a more inclusive and equitable society for all.
